note: Manifest specific to Kali 2026.1, tuned for the tools added in 2025.4 and 2026.1. Most tools ship preinstalled, so bootstrap mainly handles the non-preinstalled ones and MCP registration.
kaliNewTools2026_1: adaptixc2 — post-exploitation and adversary simulation framework (apt install adaptixc2)
atomic-operator — Atomic Red Team test runner (apt install atomic-operator)
fluxion — WiFi social-engineering audit tool (apt install fluxion)
gef — enhanced GDB debugging framework (apt install gef)
metasploitmcp — Metasploit MCP Server (apt install metasploitmcp)
sstimap — automated SSTI detection tool (apt install sstimap)
wpprobe — WordPress plugin enumeration (apt install wpprobe)
xsstrike — advanced XSS scanner (apt install xsstrike)
kaliNewTools2025_4: bpf-linker — BPF static linker (apt install bpf-linker)
evil-winrm-py — WinRM remote execution in Python (apt install evil-winrm-py)
hexstrike-ai — AI MCP security automation platform (apt install hexstrike-ai)
kaliNativeMCP: mcp-kali-server — official Kali MCP server, connecting AI to the Kali terminal (apt install mcp-kali-server, port 5000)
metasploitmcp — Metasploit MCP Server (apt install metasploitmcp, port 8085)
hexstrike-ai — MCP automation for 150+ security tools (apt install hexstrike-ai)

capabilities.name: jadx
capabilities.kaliNote: Not preinstalled on Kali; download from the GitHub release

capabilities.name: apktool
capabilities.kaliNote: apt install apktool is enough; if that version is old, download the latest from GitHub

capabilities.name: frida
capabilities.kaliNote: pip3 install frida-tools, or apt install python3-frida-tools

capabilities.name: idalib-mcp
postInstallSteps: Restart IDA Pro so the plugin takes effect
Once IDA opens a file, MCP listens automatically on 127.0.0.1:13337
capabilities.kaliNote: Requires the Linux build of IDA Pro

capabilities.name: idapro
capabilities.portNote: With multiple IDA instances the port increments (13337→13338→...); check the [MCP] port=xxxxx line in the IDA Output window
capabilities.kaliNote: Requires the Linux build of IDA Pro, installed to /opt/idapro/

capabilities.name: r2
capabilities.kaliNote: Preinstalled on Kali. For the newest version, download the .deb from GitHub

capabilities.name: rabin2
capabilities.kaliNote: Installed together with radare2

capabilities.name: adb
capabilities.kaliNote: apt install adb

capabilities.name: ghidra-mcp
postInstallSteps: Install the plugin zip into Ghidra: File → Install Extensions → select the downloaded zip
The MCP server listens on localhost:8765 once a Ghidra project is open
capabilities.kaliNote: apt install ghidra, or download from GitHub

capabilities.name: seclists
capabilities.kaliNote: apt install seclists, which installs to /usr/share/seclists/

capabilities.name: burpsuite-mcp
capabilities.manualInstallHint: BurpSuite is preinstalled on Kali; search the extension marketplace for the MCP plugin, and once started it listens on localhost:9876
capabilities.kaliNote: BurpSuite Community is preinstalled on Kali; the MCP plugin must be installed manually

capabilities.name: nmap
capabilities.kaliNote: Preinstalled on Kali

capabilities.kaliNote: Preinstalled on Kali

capabilities.kaliNote: Preinstalled on Kali

capabilities.name: hydra
capabilities.kaliNote: Preinstalled on Kali

capabilities.name: gobuster
capabilities.kaliNote: Preinstalled on Kali

capabilities.name: ffuf
capabilities.kaliNote: Preinstalled on Kali

capabilities.name: msfconsole
capabilities.kaliNote: Preinstalled on Kali

capabilities.name: nuclei
capabilities.kaliNote: go install, or download from the GitHub release

capabilities.name: mcp-kali-server
capabilities.kaliNote: Officially included in Kali 2026.1. After apt install, start the API server with kali-server-mcp and connect AI clients with mcp-server. It can invoke any terminal tool directly, such as nmap/nxc/curl/gobuster.

capabilities.name: metasploitmcp
capabilities.kaliNote: New in Kali 2026.1. An MCP interface to the Metasploit Framework, supporting both HTTP and stdio transports.

capabilities.name: hexstrike-ai
capabilities.kaliNote: New in Kali 2025.4. An AI MCP security automation platform exposing 150+ security tools to AI agents over the MCP protocol.

capabilities.name: adaptixc2
capabilities.kaliNote: New in Kali 2026.1. An extensible post-exploitation and adversary simulation framework.

capabilities.name: atomic-operator
capabilities.kaliNote: New in Kali 2026.1. Runs Atomic Red Team test cases across platforms.

capabilities.name: sstimap
capabilities.kaliNote: New in Kali 2026.1. Automated detection and exploitation of SSTI (server-side template injection).

capabilities.name: xsstrike
capabilities.kaliNote: New in Kali 2026.1. An advanced XSS scanner covering DOM, reflected and stored detection.

capabilities.name: wpprobe
capabilities.kaliNote: New in Kali 2026.1. A fast WordPress plugin enumeration tool.

capabilities.name: fluxion
capabilities.kaliNote: New in Kali 2026.1. A WiFi security auditing and social-engineering research tool.

capabilities.name: gef
capabilities.kaliNote: New in Kali 2026.1. GDB Enhanced Features, a modernized GDB debugging experience. Once installed, gdb loads GEF automatically.

capabilities.name: evil-winrm-py
capabilities.kaliNote: New in Kali 2025.4. WinRM remote command execution in Python, for Windows post-exploitation.

capabilities.name: pentestswarm
capabilities.kaliNote: A swarm-intelligence pentest framework. Run via go install or Docker. Supports MCP server mode (pentestswarm mcp serve). Requires a Claude or Ollama API key.

capabilities.name: coercer
capabilities.kaliNote: A Windows authentication coercion tool, used for NTLM relay in AD attacks.
